name: Ensemble Simulator
detailed_description:
Ensemble Simulator” is a simulation game that allows you to create a musical space that resembles real orchestra conducting using your own music data.

The ultra-stereoscopic sound technology of Sound xR™ allows you to easily create a stereoscopic sound even with your own Threteo headphones. It is also recommended for brass band part practice and orchestra setting simulation.

Simply place the instrument parts (sound sources) freely on the field, press the play button, and the ensemble you have constructed will sound three-dimensional. Experience the soft swell of the strings, the powerful roar of the brass, and the detailed accents of the percussion instruments, all in the space of your choice.

The Ensemble Simulator uses Yamaha Corporation's Sound xR™ three-dimensional acoustic technology.

“This application uses Sound xR spatial audio processing engine for earphones and headphones, i.e. Binauralizer from Yamaha Corporation .”

Free creation of acoustic spaces

Easy operation: Just place your own audio

The composition is up to you: from traditional orchestras to avant-garde sound installations

Unique musical experience: Build your own sound scene

Simulation at home: Batch playback and placement simulation of individually recorded sound sources for wind bands and orchestras

Session from a distance: Simulated sessions are possible by simply collecting and playing back the performance data of friends in remote locations

Realistic orchestral experience

Startup with a single playback button: All parts resonate simultaneously for a stunning sound

Conductor's point of view: Conducting in a three-dimensional acoustic world through headphones or speakers

Maximum immersion: Realism as if a live orchestra is playing right in front of you

Immersive sound walkthrough

Freedom of movement: Discover sound details by walking through the field and approaching specific parts

Spatial expansion: Feel the deep harmonies in the string section and the powerful rhythms on the percussion side

Sound Journey: A new kind of sound walk that feels like an exploration of the sound world

Expandability to meet your creativity

Import your own audio files: not only orchestral instruments, but also piano solos, ethnic instruments, electronic sounds, and more

Free to create your own soundscape: Create your own unique sound space with new sound sources and combinations

Sound Artist Experience: Unlimited possibilities to express your imagination and curiosity through sound

Now, create the ideal musical space you envision and weave your own resonance. Orchestra, band, sound art - your sound will color the world.

Translated with (free version)

short_description: 「アンサンブル・シミュレーター」は、あなた自身の楽曲データを用いて、 本物のオーケストラ指揮さながらの音楽空間を生み出せるシミュレーションゲームです。 フィールド上に楽器パート（音源）を 自由自在に配置 し、再生ボタンを押すだけで、あなたが構築したアンサンブルが立体的な響きを奏でます。弦楽器の柔和なうねり、金管の力強い咆哮、打楽器の細やかなアクセント――すべてをお好みの空間で体感しましょう。

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - i7 Quad Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
